population: CANON-P0/PROG-A0 train1421 only; V8 representation has previously seen this lineage, so OOF tests the new head only
representation: frozen V8 sequential_head.pt action_features at exact history preceding swap; feature is alternate-minus-V8-next action feature
label: Among non-breaking actions, all actions with the maximum number of repaired attainable anchors are positive; if none repairs, STAY only. Token cost is measured at rollout, not used to choose one arbitrary oracle action.
loss: set-valued negative log probability mass of positive actions
model: single linear scalar head, STAY logit fixed zero; frozen V8 backbone, LoRA and sequential head
split: four pre-existing stable SHA256 query folds; train-fold-only feature normalization
decoder: argmax over STAY and 3 swaps, with STAY first for exact score ties; at most one swap per trajectory
go_gate: Direct OOF rollout: every attainable-anchor success and Complete nondecrease versus V8, mean cumulative context tokens nonincrease, and at least one strict improvement; auxiliary loss/accuracy cannot override this gate
